verdict.rationale: LegalZoom's LLC formation page lists an EIN as one of the deliverables of its formation packages, used 'to file taxes, open bank accounts, and build your staff.' That directly covers the core of the founder's story, obtaining an EIN through the platform. The evidence is one short line with no detail on how it is obtained or which tiers include it. Missing for 10: confirmation that the EIN service also covers corporations (C/S corp), which package tiers or add-on price include it, a description of the filing process and turnaround, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
